topics.title: Sami spends too much time on social media. Write a paragraph giving him advice.
guiding_questions: Why is spending too much time on social media bad?
What can Sami do instead of using social media?
How can he limit his screen time?
How can he improve his exam results?
topics.sample_essay: Sami should stop spending too much time on social media. He can limit his screen time to one hour a day. He should focus on his studies and make a study plan. He can also do sports or read books. This will help him get better exam results and make his parents happy.

topics.title: Sarah can't make friends in Germany. Write a paragraph giving her advice.
guiding_questions: What can she do to learn German?
How can she meet new people?
What advice would you give her to feel less lonely?
topics.sample_essay: Sarah should try to learn German to communicate with others. She can join a club or a sports team at school to meet new people. She can also talk to her classmates and ask for help. Making friends takes time, but she should not give up. She will feel less lonely if she keeps trying.
